title: The 10 Best Combination Wrench Sets
subtitle: SAE and metric combination wrench sets for home, garage and auto work, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A combination wrench has an open end on one side and a closed box end on the other, the basic tool for nuts and bolts a socket can't reach. We ranked 10 best-sellers from CRAFTSMAN, GEARWRENCH, TEKTON, NEIKO and value brands on rating, review volume and features (SAE and metric sizes, storage, a lifetime warranty and long-pattern bodies). Start with a set that has both SAE and metric.

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: EFFICERE 24-Piece Master Combination Wrench Set with Roll-up Pouch, SAE 1/4" to 1", Metric 8mm to 24mm
products.verdict: The best-selling and most-reviewed set here: 24 drop-forged chrome vanadium wrenches in SAE and metric, raised-panel bodies, a heavy-duty roll pouch and a lifetime guarantee, for very little money.
products.best_for: A first wrench set for home, car and bike work.
products.skip_if: You want a name-brand set you can get replaced at a hardware store.

products.name: SEDY 30-Piece SAE and Metric Combination Wrench Set with Storage Rack, 12 Point
products.verdict: A 30-piece SAE and metric set with laser-etched sizes and a folding storage rack with grippers that hold each wrench in place.
products.best_for: Garages that want every wrench on one rack.
products.skip_if: You want a long track record; it has 268 reviews.

products.name: VEVOR 32-Piece SAE and Metric Combination Wrench Set, 12-Point Box End, Roll Up Pouch
products.verdict: A 32-piece SAE and metric set in a labeled roll-up pouch, with 12-point box ends and 15-degree open ends.
products.best_for: Covering most car and home sizes on a budget.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN 7-Piece SAE Wrench Set in Pouch (CMMT21085)
products.verdict: A small, cheap CRAFTSMAN SAE set with full polish chrome, 12-point box ends and a pouch, for a kitchen drawer or a bike bag.
products.best_for: A starter or backup set of the common SAE sizes.
products.skip_if: You work on metric cars or bikes; it's SAE only.

products.name: HORUSDY 26-Piece Combination Wrench Set with Roll-up Pouch, SAE 1/4"-1" and Metric
products.verdict: A budget SAE and metric set in drop-forged, heat-treated chrome vanadium with a roll-up pouch, and 1,401 reviews behind it.
products.best_for: Household and garage work on a budget.
products.skip_if: You want a lifetime warranty in writing.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN 32-Piece SAE/Metric Combination Wrench Set (CMMT12080)
products.verdict: A full 32-piece CRAFTSMAN SAE and metric set with full polish chrome, large size markings and CRAFTSMAN's full lifetime warranty.
products.best_for: Anyone who wants a name-brand set with a lifetime warranty.
products.skip_if: You want storage included; none is listed.

products.name: Neiko 03574A Jumbo Combination Wrench Set, 16 Piece, SAE 1/4" to 1-1/4", Raised Panel
products.verdict: A 'jumbo' SAE set that runs up to 1-1/4 inch, with raised-panel bodies and a black oxide finish, for big fasteners on trucks, tractors and equipment.
products.best_for: Big SAE fasteners on trucks, trailers and farm equipment.
cons: Black oxide is less corrosion-resistant than chrome

products.name: GEARWRENCH 44-Piece 12-Point Master Combination Wrench Set, Metric/SAE (81919)
products.verdict: A pro master set with 44 long-pattern wrenches whose box ends grip the flats of the fastener (off-corner loading) to reduce rounding.
products.best_for: Mechanics who want one complete pro-grade set.

products.name: TEKTON 19-Piece Metric Combination Wrench Set with Rack (WCB91202)
products.verdict: A full metric run from 6 to 24 mm, with no gaps, in a wrench rack, from a brand known for hand tools.
products.best_for: Anyone working on metric cars, motorcycles and machines.

products.name: EFFICERE Max Torque 15-Piece Long Pattern Combination Wrench Set, Metric 8-22 mm
products.verdict: A metric set with long-pattern bodies for more leverage and a V-cut open end that grips four flats of a nut, plus a folding storage rack.
products.best_for: Metric work where leverage on stuck bolts matters.

avoid.name: VEVOR 44-Piece Combination Wrench Set, Metric 6 to 32mm, SAE 1/4" to 1-1/4"
avoid.flag: Title says 44 pieces; the listing says 25
avoid.verdict: You can't tell from the listing whether you're getting 44 wrenches or 25.
reasons: The title says '44-Piece', but the first bullet says 'The 25-piece combined SAE and metric combination wrench set includes 6 to 32 mm and 1/4" to 1-1/4"'.
With the piece count contradicted, the rest of the listing (sizes, storage, what's in the box) can't be relied on either.
If you want a big set, the GEARWRENCH 81919 is a clearly described 44-piece set, and VEVOR's own 32-piece set lists its contents consistently.

buyers_guide.a: Most cars, bikes, appliances and furniture built in the last 30 years use metric. Older American cars, trucks, trailers and farm gear use SAE. A set with both covers almost everything around a house.

A 12-point box end grabs a bolt at twice as many angles, handy in tight spots. A 6-point end holds more of the bolt's flats and is less likely to round off a stubborn or rusty bolt. Most sets here are 12-point; GEARWRENCH also sells 6-point sets.
Long-pattern wrenches have longer handles for more leverage on stuck bolts. They can be harder to swing in tight engine bays.
Not to start. Plain combination wrenches are cheaper, stronger and thinner. Add a ratcheting set later for repetitive work in tight spaces.
CRAFTSMAN lists a full lifetime warranty on the 32-piece set, and EFFICERE backs its 24-piece set with a lifetime guarantee. Hand tools rarely break, but a free replacement is nice if one does.
